## 中文原文
今天早上开会，同事分享一份项目报告。报告里有几处数据有问题。会后你私下提醒这位同事，他感谢了你，并且说会马上修改这些数据。

## My translation
In today's morning meeting, one of my colleagues shared a project report.
But some of the data in the report had problems.
I reminded the colleague of the problems in private after meeting.
He thanked me for the reminder and said he would revise the data right away.

## Revised version
At this morning's meeting, one of my colleagues presented a project report.
However, some of the data in the report is incorrect.
I pointed out these issues to him privately after the meeting.
He thanked me for letting him know and said he'd fix the data immediately.

## Key phrases
- at this morning's meeting
- present a report
- point out issues
- fix the data
